# NIST AI RMF Static RAG Demo

> Dual-readable Markdown extracts of NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST.AI.100-1) and the Generative AI Profile (NIST.AI.600-1), plus a static hybrid retrieval demo with section citations. **Not official NIST output.** Cite the official DOIs for normative use: https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.100-1 and https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.600-1
>
> Demo home: https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/
> This corpus is separate from the CoSAI SRF knowledge graph and from the TACIP orphan at /nist/.

## How agents should use this corpus

1. **Authoritative quote / cite:** fetch the clean Markdown sources below; quote by `section_path` / heading anchor. Prefer the official NIST PDF/DOI when the answer is normative.
2. **Programmatic scenario retrieval (plain HTTP, pure JSON):** fetch a precomputed file under `/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/` (see index below), or fetch `data/chunks.json` (+ manifest) and rank locally.
3. **Always verify** citations against the source Markdown (or official PDF).
4. **Do not** treat fused scores as official NIST guidance.
5. **Do not** use `?format=json` as a general agent endpoint. A plain GET returns the HTML page shell; ranking only runs if client JavaScript executes. Prefer `/retrieve/*.json` or `data/chunks.json`.
6. **Applicability:** NIST.AI.600-1 supplements and does not replace NIST.AI.100-1.
7. **Human + agent howto:** [HOWTO.md](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/HOWTO.md) (architecture, llms.txt vs RAG, copy-ready prompts). Guide section on the demo page: https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/#what-this-is
8. **What this demonstrates:** dual-readable NIST extracts, static hybrid RAG with section citations, separate human vs HTTP-agent paths, corpus isolation from CoSAI SRF. Not official NIST packaging or OT-safe assistant use. https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/#what-this-demonstrates
9. **Operational risk:** Assistant answers that drive OT config, automation code, vendor/selection decisions, diagnostics, or OT-actionable summaries can have the same impact as wiring a model into control. See mitigated vs not: https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/#assistant-ot-risks and [HOWTO.md](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/HOWTO.md#risks-general-purpose-assistants-and-operational-impact)

## Clean Markdown sources (authoritative)

- [AI RMF 1.0 (NIST.AI.100-1)](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sources/nist-ai-100-1.md)
- [Generative AI Profile (NIST.AI.600-1)](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sources/nist-ai-600-1.md)
- [Attribution](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sources/ATTRIBUTION.md)
- [Full concatenated sources](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/llms-full.txt)

## Programmatic retrieval (static JSON over HTTP)

### Precomputed scenario results (recommended for agents)

- [Scenario index](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/index.json)
- [human-oversight](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/human-oversight.json)
- [confabulation](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/confabulation.json)
- [govern-inventory](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/govern-inventory.json)
- [supply-chain](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/supply-chain.json)
- [prompt-injection](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/prompt-injection.json)

Each file is ranked hybrid retrieval output (`matched_chunks`, scores, citations). Content-Type is `application/json` on GitHub Pages.

### Full corpus (rank locally for arbitrary queries)

- [Corpus manifest](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/corpus-manifest.json)
- [Chunks](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/chunks.json): primary corpus (`chunk_id`, `section_path`, `anchor`, `topics`, `related_controls`, `text`, `source_md`)
- [BM25 index](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/bm25.json)
- [Embeddings](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/embeddings.json)
- [Graph edges](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/graph-edges.json)

## Browser UI only

- Interactive UI: https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/?q=...
- `?format=json` is a **browser debug mode** (requires JS). It is not a server-side JSON API. Agents should use `/retrieve/*.json` or `data/chunks.json` instead.

## Official NIST publications

- [NIST.AI.100-1 PDF](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ai/NIST.AI.100-1.pdf)
- [NIST.AI.600-1 PDF](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ai/NIST.AI.600-1.pdf)
- [AI RMF program page](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework)
